features.title: Fix ruled surface bug for smooth NURBS loft
features.user_visible_behavior: The 3D model looks perfectly smooth and curved (silky smooth) longitudinally instead of having flat segmented faces.
verification: Change makeLoft(..., True, True) to makeLoft(..., True, False)
evidence: Verified via ./scripts/verify.sh with code 0 (execution time reduced to ~13s).
makeLoft Ruled parameter successfully changed to False.
features.notes: User complained model was not silky smooth. Discovered that Ruled=True was passed to makeLoft, creating flat segments. Changing to False creates a smooth B-Spline interpolation.
